en.title: The Application & Test Process
en.mnemonic: Two test requirements: knowledge of Canada + adequate English/French — but since Oct 2017 language is assessed SEPARATELY. Age 55+ = no test required.
keyFactsChecklist: Ceremony: oath, sign form, receive certificate

en.question: The Government of Canada offers free flights to take the citizenship test for applicants.
What do new Canadians do at the citizenship ceremony?
options: Take the Oath of Citizenship, sign the oath form, and receive their Canadian Citizenship Certificate
Vote in their first federal election
Donate to the Government of Canada
en.explanation: Page 10: 'At the ceremony, you will: Take the Oath of Citizenship; Sign the oath form; and Receive your Canadian Citizenship Certificate.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 10: 'At the ceremony, you will: Take the Oath of Citizenship; Sign the oath form; and Receive your Canadian Citizenship Certificate.'
Voting is separate from the ceremony itself.
Canada permits dual citizenship; the ceremony doesn't require renunciation.

en.question: What is the purpose of the citizenship test?
options: To assess your knowledge of Canada and the rights and responsibilities of being a citizen
To test your French/English fluency only
To determine if you can run for office
en.explanation: Page 9 (and p. 106): 'The citizenship test is used to assess your knowledge of Canada and the rights and responsibilities of being a citizen in Canada.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 9 (and p. 106): 'The citizenship test is used to assess your knowledge of Canada and the rights and responsibilities of being a citizen in Canada.'
Language is a separate requirement (p. 82). The test assesses knowledge of Canada.
Background checks are part of the application process (p. 8), not the test.

en.question: What will officials check when you apply for citizenship?
options: Your status, that you are not prohibited from citizenship, and that you meet the requirements
en.explanation: Page 8: 'When you apply for citizenship, officials will check your status, verify that you are not prohibited from citizenship.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 8: 'When you apply for citizenship, officials will check your status, verify that you are not prohibited from citizenship.'
Not a Canadian citizenship-application criterion per p. 8.
